# --- Services ---
# Cisco IOS/IOS-XE sends service=shell for exec authorization and expects
# priv-lvl; the anchors keep 'exec' as the label for the tier.
# Juniper requests service=junos-exec and expects local-user-name.
# Each device type only requests its own service; the other is ignored.

# Cisco exec - readonly (priv-lvl 1)
exec_readonly: &exec_readonly
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [1]

# Juniper junos-exec - readonly
# "RO-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_readonly: &junos_exec_readonly
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RO-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - operator (priv-lvl 7)

# --- Services ---
# Cisco IOS/IOS-XE sends service=shell for exec authorization and expects
# priv-lvl; the anchors keep 'exec' as the label for the tier.
# Juniper requests service=junos-exec and expects local-user-name.
# Each device type only requests its own service; the other is ignored.

# Cisco exec - readonly (priv-lvl 1)
exec_readonly: &exec_readonly
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [1]

# Juniper junos-exec - readonly
# "RO-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_readonly: &junos_exec_readonly
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RO-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - operator (priv-lvl 7)
exec_operator: &exec_operator
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [7]

# Juniper junos-exec - operator
# "OP-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_operator: &junos_exec_operator
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["OP-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - superuser (priv-lvl 15)
exec_superuser: &exec_superuser
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [15]

# Juniper junos-exec - superuser
# "RW-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_superuser: &junos_exec_superuser
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RW-CLASS"]

# --- Groups ---
# Command rules come from commands.<group> in tacctl.yaml.
readonly: &readonly
  name: readonly
  services:
    - *exec_readonly
    - *junos_exec_readonly
  commands:
    - name: "show"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "ping"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "traceroute"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_deny
  accounter: *file_accounter

operator: &operator
  name: operator
  services:
    - *exec_operator
    - *junos_exec_operator
  accounter: *file_accounter

superuser: &superuser
  name: superuser
  services:
    - *exec_superuser
    - *junos_exec_superuser
  commands:
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_permit
  accounter: *file_accounter

# --- Users ---
users:

  # alice
  - name: alice
    scopes: ["prod", "lab"]
    groups: [*superuser]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_alice
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # bob
  - name: bob
    scopes: ["lab"]
    groups: [*operator]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_bob
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # carol
  - name: carol
    scopes: ["lab", "dmz"]
    groups: [*readonly]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_carol
    accounter: *file_accounter

# answers a client with the first entry whose prefix contains it.
secrets:

config:
# GENERATED by tacctl from /etc/tacctl/store.yaml and tacctl.yaml. Edits here are overwritten.
# Use tacctl commands, or 'tacctl store import --replace' to adopt manual edits.
#
# Tacquito TACACS+ server configuration (Cisco IOS/IOS-XE + Juniper).

# --- Type constants ---
authenticator_type_bcrypt: &authenticator_type_bcrypt 1
action_deny:  &action_deny  1
action_permit: &action_permit 2
accounter_type_file: &accounter_type_file 3
handler_type_start: &handler_type_start 1
provider_type_prefix: &provider_type_prefix 1

# --- Accounting ---
file_accounter: &file_accounter
  name: tacquito_accounter
  type: *accounter_type_file

# --- Per-user bcrypt authenticators ---
# A disabled account and the 'root' accounting sink carry a well-formed
# hash that no password matches.

bcrypt_2bN: &bcrypt_2bN
  type: *authenticator_type_bcrypt
  options:
    hash: 24326224313224646f6e74636172652e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e

bcrypt_NzN: &bcrypt_NzN
  type: *authenticator_type_bcrypt
  options:
    hash: 243262243132242e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e

bcrypt_l-f0-FQ1H: &bcrypt_l-f0-FQ1H
  type: *authenticator_type_bcrypt
  options:
    hash: 243262243132242e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e

# --- Services ---
# Cisco IOS/IOS-XE sends service=shell for exec authorization and expects
# priv-lvl; the anchors keep 'exec' as the label for the tier.
# Juniper requests service=junos-exec and expects local-user-name.
# Each device type only requests its own service; the other is ignored.

# Cisco exec - readonly (priv-lvl 1)
exec_readonly: &exec_readonly
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [1]

# Juniper junos-exec - readonly
# "RO-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_readonly: &junos_exec_readonly
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RO-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - operator (priv-lvl 7)
exec_operator: &exec_operator
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [7]

# Juniper junos-exec - operator
# "OP-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_operator: &junos_exec_operator
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["OP-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - superuser (priv-lvl 15)
exec_superuser: &exec_superuser
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [15]

# Juniper junos-exec - superuser
# "RW-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_superuser: &junos_exec_superuser
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RW-CLASS"]

# --- Groups ---
# Command rules come from commands.<group> in tacctl.yaml.
readonly: &readonly
  name: readonly
  services:
    - *exec_readonly
    - *junos_exec_readonly
  commands:
    - name: "show"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "ping"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "traceroute"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_deny
  accounter: *file_accounter

operator: &operator
  name: operator
  services:
    - *exec_operator
    - *junos_exec_operator
  commands:
    - name: "}&:!^~b$"
      action: *action_permit
  accounter: *file_accounter

superuser: &superuser
  name: superuser
  services:
    - *exec_superuser
    - *junos_exec_superuser
  commands:
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_permit
  accounter: *file_accounter

# --- Users ---
users:

  # 2bN
  - name: "2bN"
    scopes: []
    groups: [*operator]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_2bN
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # NzN
  - name: NzN
    scopes: []
    groups: [*superuser]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_NzN
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # l-f0-FQ1H
  - name: l-f0-FQ1H
    scopes: []
    groups: [*readonly]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_l-f0-FQ1H
    accounter: *file_accounter

# --- Secret Providers (Scopes) ---
# One entry per (scope, prefix), most specific prefix first: tacquito
# answers a client with the first entry whose prefix contains it.
secrets:
  - name: v_sD
    secret:
      group: tacquito
      key: "9?\":+~\u2026\U0001f511\">`[\",%\xfc>Y\u2026\xa0<={-\xa0("
    handler:
      type: *handler_type_start
    type: *provider_type_prefix
    options:
      prefixes: |
        [
          "100.64.0.0/10"
        ]
  - name: v_sD
    secret:
      group: tacquito
      key: "9?\":+~\u2026\U0001f511\">`[\",%\xfc>Y\u2026\xa0<={-\xa0("
    handler:
      type: *handler_type_start
    type: *provider_type_prefix
    options:
      prefixes: |
        [
          "fd00:10::/64"
        ]

# --- Connection filters ---
prefix_allow: ["::/0"]

# --- Services ---
# Cisco IOS/IOS-XE sends service=shell for exec authorization and expects
# priv-lvl; the anchors keep 'exec' as the label for the tier.
# Juniper requests service=junos-exec and expects local-user-name.
# Each device type only requests its own service; the other is ignored.

# Cisco exec - readonly (priv-lvl 1)
exec_readonly: &exec_readonly
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [1]

# Juniper junos-exec - readonly
# "RO-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_readonly: &junos_exec_readonly
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RO-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - operator (priv-lvl 7)
exec_operator: &exec_operator
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [7]

# Juniper junos-exec - operator
# "OP-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_operator: &junos_exec_operator
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["OP-CLASS"]

# Cisco exec - superuser (priv-lvl 15)
exec_superuser: &exec_superuser
  name: shell
  set_values:
    - name: priv-lvl
      values: [15]

# Juniper junos-exec - superuser
# "RW-CLASS" must match a local template user on Juniper devices
junos_exec_superuser: &junos_exec_superuser
  name: junos-exec
  set_values:
    - name: local-user-name
      values: ["RW-CLASS"]

# --- Groups ---
# Command rules come from commands.<group> in tacctl.yaml.
readonly: &readonly
  name: readonly
  services:
    - *exec_readonly
    - *junos_exec_readonly
  commands:
    - name: "show"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "ping"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "traceroute"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_deny
  accounter: *file_accounter

operator: &operator
  name: operator
  services:
    - *exec_operator
    - *junos_exec_operator
  commands:
    - name: "show"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "ping"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "traceroute"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "terminal"
      action: *action_permit
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_deny
  accounter: *file_accounter

superuser: &superuser
  name: superuser
  services:
    - *exec_superuser
    - *junos_exec_superuser
  commands:
    - name: "*"
      action: *action_permit
  accounter: *file_accounter

# --- Users ---
users:

  # G
  - name: G
    scopes: ["AEHP3t", "fvkrQtS", "ufCBPC6"]
    groups: [*readonly]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_G
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # Gqsj
  - name: Gqsj
    scopes: []
    groups: [*operator]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_Gqsj
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # crWmXqcnvF
  - name: crWmXqcnvF
    scopes: ["AEHP3t", "ufCBPC6"]
    groups: [*superuser]
    authenticator: *bcrypt_crWmXqcnvF
    accounter: *file_accounter

  # j6Oz
  - name: j6Oz
    scopes: []
    groups: [*superuser]
